title: rpt page record
description: One page of report-level prose, such as an executive summary: a file in pages/. Unknown frontmatter keys appear as extra members. Schema version 2.

id.description: Page ID; assigned by rpt page add when absent.

path.description: The page file, relative to the report root. rpt page add ignores it.

body.description: Markdown after the frontmatter. ## headings in it are the page's own, not sections.

evidence.description: Evidence files, relative to the page file.

rev.description: The page file's revision. Opaque: compare it, never compute it. Pass it back as --if-rev so a write is refused if the page changed since this read.

lines.description: Where the page's parts sit in its file. Given by rpt page get --lines; rpt page add ignores it.

file.description: Absolute path of the page file, in the form rpt opened the report by, symlinks not resolved.

frontmatter.description: Where each top-level frontmatter key sits.

body.description: The line the body starts on.
